description: This is a Java test source file for the UserDAO class, containing unit tests for user management functionalities in the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: UserDAOTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the UserDAO implementation, including user creation, password change, and secret question handling.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Setup method run before each test to initialize a User object and save it via the UserDAO.

methods.name: getUsers_shouldEscapeSqlWildcardsInSearchPhrase
methods.description: Test to ensure that SQL wildcards in search phrases are properly escaped.

methods.name: saveUser_shouldCreateNewUser
methods.description: Test to verify saving a new user creates a user in the database.

methods.name: updateUserPassword_shouldNotOverwriteUserSecretQuestionOrAnswer
methods.description: Verifies that updating a user's password does not overwrite secret questions or answers.

methods.name: saveUser_shouldNotOverwriteUserSecretQuestionOrAnswer
methods.description: Ensures that saving the user doesn't overwrite secret question and answer if they are already set.

methods.name: changePassword_shouldNotAllowChangingPasswordFromUnknownClass
methods.description: Test that changing password from an unknown caller class throws an exception.

methods.name: changePassword_shouldNotOverwriteUserSecretQuestionOrAnswer
methods.description: Checks that changing the password preserves the secret question and answer.

methods.name: changeHashedPassword_shouldNotOverwriteUserSecretQuestionOrAnswer
methods.description: Ensures that changing password with a hashed method preserves secret info.

methods.name: isSecretAnswer_shouldReturnTrueWhenTheAnswerMatches
methods.description: Verifies that the secret answer verification returns true for a matching answer.

methods.name: isSecretAnswer_shouldReturnFalseWhenTheAnswerDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Checks that secret answer verification returns false for a non-matching answer.
